albums.note: album slots are tracked occupants, not catalogued specimens

next_ids.note: Name photos of a new piece NOID_... and use NEW-1, NEW-2 in change files; the pipeline assigns these ids in order. Only another contributor's file merged first can take them.

truth.note: contradictions and over-specific claims; list in data/truth.json

phase1.note: a piece is through Phase 1 when it has all 7 fields; the per-coin list is in data/reshoot.json (phase1)

trust.note: every fact the coin view shows, by its certainty label; cited or confirmed = verified + owner + reference
